body_markdown:
Every list of the best gamification apps for Shopify ranks by review count. None of them ranks by the number that hits your P&L: the discount each app gives away per order. Playably sits first on that measure because the brand funds $0 of the reward.


This ranking scores eight apps on margin cost per order first, subscription second and fit third. The assumptions are published so you can rerun the math with your own numbers.


If margin is the measure that matters, Playably is the best option on this list, and it’s the only app where a win is funded by someone other than the brand.


## **Key takeaways**


- **The best gamification apps for Shopify differ most on who funds the reward,** and review counts don’t show it.
- **Spin-to-win wheels cost about $10 per redeemed $80 order** on a 12.5% average slice, plus the subscription.
- **Playably ranks first because the platform funds the cashback,** not the brand, and shoppers pay full price.
- **Draw-based apps are cheap but long-odds.** One winner in 1,000 orders is a 0.1% chance.
- **The most expensive apps by margin are the ones built on flat-dollar offers,** like “$20 off for the next 50 buyers.”


## **How this ranking works**


The model store does 1,000 orders a month at an $80 AOV. Each app is scored on the reward the brand itself pays for on an average order.


Three assumptions:


- **Wheels:** a 12.5% average redeemed slice, so $10 on an $80 order.
- **Draw apps:** one winner a month, with the full order returned as store credit.
- **Platform fees are listed separately.** A fee is a cost, but it isn’t a markdown on the product.

## **The apps in detail**


### **1. Playably: $0 of brand-funded reward**


The brand picks a real-world trigger, shoppers pay full price, and every order in the window is refunded 100% if it hits. Playably funds those refunds and the brand sets a[liability cap](https://playably.ai/pages/pricing) before launch.


The published results come from full-price campaigns:[BlackBoxMyCar](https://playably.ai/pages/black-box-my-car) at 18.25× ROAS on rebate ads,[Buckle Me Baby Coats](https://playably.ai/pages/buckle-me-baby-coats) at 40% higher AOV.


#### **Who it fits**


Brands with a promotional moment to build around. Campaigns run in windows, not as an always-on widget.


No other app on this list can claim the $0 row, because in every one of them a win is a cost the brand absorbs.[See the case-study library](https://playably.ai/pages/case-studies) .


### **2. Win Back by Commerce Pro: cheapest per order**


One winner a month returns about 8 cents an order at retail, less at cost of goods. The tradeoff is odds shoppers can dismiss.


### **3. Cheers Cash: predictions, brand-funded gift cards**


Only correct predictions win, which caps reward spend. The $4,000 monthly fee plus 2% of attributed sales doesn’t cap, and adds $1.60 to every $80 order before rewards.


### **4. Growth Suite: fewer codes, still codes**


Timing a code to a visitor about to leave is smarter than showing everyone a wheel. It’s still a markdown on every converted order.


### **5–7. Spin-a-Sale, Wheelio and Privy: every spin is a code**


Identical on margin, so they rank by subscription: Spin-a-Sale from $9.99, Wheelio from $14.92, Privy’s Spin to Win inside Displays from $24. Wheels are good at email capture and expensive at conversion, and our[spin-to-win alternative page](https://playably.ai/pages/spin-to-win-alternative) covers the swap.


### **8. Quikly: deepest per-order discount**


Flat-dollar urgency offers are a 25% discount on an $80 order. That’s fine for a drop, costly as a habit.


## **What the ranking doesn’t measure**


Two things this axis ignores, and both matter.


**Setup effort.** Wheels are live in an afternoon. A rebate campaign takes about 14 days to build.


**Always-on coverage.** Wheels run all year. Playably campaigns run in windows, so most brands pair a rebate with a no-code capture method between campaigns.


## **Summary**


Playably ranks first because it’s the only app here where the reward costs the brand $0, which is the whole point of ranking these by margin.


Gamification on Shopify quietly became a nicer way to hand out coupons. The wheel spins, the confetti drops, and the order ships at 12.5% off.


The only honest way to rank these apps is by what they cost per order, and on that axis a mechanic where the platform funds the reward wins by definition. If your margin can’t absorb another $10 an order this Q4, that’s the axis to shop on.


## **Score your own stack**


Take last quarter’s promotional orders, multiply by the average discount actually redeemed, and compare that with a capped campaign quote.

## **FAQ**


- **What are the best gamification apps for Shopify in 2026?** By margin cost: Playably, Win Back, Cheers Cash, Growth Suite, Spin-a-Sale, Wheelio, Privy, Quikly.
- **Which Shopify gamification app doesn’t use discount codes?** Playably, Win Back and Cheers Cash. Only Playably funds the reward itself.
- **How much does a spin wheel cost in margin?** Roughly $10 per redeemed $80 order at a 12.5% average slice.
- **Is Playably a Shopify app?** Yes. It runs on any Shopify plan, and the checkout opt-in doesn’t require Shopify Plus.
- **What’s the cheapest gamification app?** Spin-a-Sale at $9.99 a month by subscription, though the discounts it gives away cost far more.
